verdict.rationale: Composio supports restricting toolsets via `toolkits` param on session creation, and explicit `allowed_tools` allowlisting when creating an MCP server (e.g. GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS, GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL), plus combining mcp:true with a direct-tools preset to expose exactly a chosen tool set via one MCP URL. This directly matches per-server and per-tool allowlisting for platform engineers. Missing for 10: no evidence of role-based or team-wide policy enforcement across multiple agents, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that access control is enforced robustly in production.
